name: Unstoppable Knight
author: Rafael Garcia (Rafagars); Peanut-GB by Mahyar Koshkouei
description: Unstoppable Knight by Rafagars, a short Game Boy game made with GBDK-2020 for the Game Boy Competition 2021: a knight marches through the forest collecting every coin, dodging enemies and obstacles or blocking them with his shield. MIT license (github.com/Rafagars/Unstoppable-Knight-GB).

descriptions.it: Unstoppable Knight di Rafagars, un breve gioco per Game Boy fatto con GBDK-2020 per la Game Boy Competition 2021: un cavaliere attraversa la foresta raccogliendo tutte le monete, schivando nemici e ostacoli o parandoli con lo scudo. Licenza MIT (github.com/Rafagars/Unstoppable-Knight-GB).
